name: claude-code-desktop-sync
description: Two-way syncs stdio MCP servers between Claude Code and Claude Desktop at session start, rewriting launchers like npx to absolute paths for Desktop. HTTP or header-auth servers that cannot live in Desktop's config are reported with the exact manual step. One-sided changes propagate; conflicts are held and reported, never overwritten. Backs up before writing; a bundled skill offers on-demand sync.
